기본값은 HTTPS입니다. 암호화를 끄거나 HTTP 병행을 선택하면 공개.en: HTTPS is the default. Disabling encryption or enabling HTTP alongside HTTPS leaves HTTP traffic unencrypted. The tablet must also explicitly allow unencrypted connections.
